claim: Phase-3 primary file is converted fibre-A s1d spectrum in Solar System barycentric frame.
S1D is rebinned/merged and stretched to barycentric frame at 0.01 Angstrom step. This 2003 manual does not prove the exact HARPS_3.8 implementation.
lambda_after/lambda_before=1+BERV/c; positive BERV when Earth approaches the star. Algebraic inversion gives the preliminary topocentric estimate used here.
access_note: Primary paper text retrieved through indexed search result; direct article/PDF requests returned 403. No exact HARPS_3.8 source code was verified.
